title: CaseDecision
description: PACK-09, ADR-041/ADR-042. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.CaseDecision). The decision record of a governed case, created exactly once per case. decided_by_role names which procedural role actually decided - for party_arbitration and internal_dispute cases that is always the assigned independent_decision_maker. Evidence is referenced, never embedded. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
